requirements.quote: Endpoints MAY add reserved versions to any field where unknown or unsupported versions are ignored to test that a peer correctly ignores the value.
requirements.condition: An endpoint is populating a field in which unknown or unsupported versions are ignored.
requirements.required_behavior: The endpoint is permitted to add a reserved version to the field to test peer handling.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Reserved versions must not be added under this permission to fields where unknown or unsupported versions are not ignored.
requirements.why_checkable: The field type and inserted version value can be inspected, and the field's defined handling of unknown or unsupported versions can be verified.

requirements.quote: Endpoints MAY add reserved versions to any field where unknown or unsupported versions are ignored to test that a peer correctly ignores the value.
requirements.condition: A peer receives a field containing an added reserved version in a context where unknown or unsupported versions are ignored.
requirements.required_behavior: The peer ignores the reserved version value.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The peer must not process the reserved version as a supported version in that field.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can inject a reserved version into such a field and observe whether peer processing ignores that value.

requirements.quote: Endpoints MAY send packets with a reserved version to test that a peer correctly discards the packet.
requirements.condition: An endpoint is testing a peer's handling of reserved versions.
requirements.required_behavior: The endpoint is permitted to send a packet carrying a reserved version.
requirements.why_checkable: The transmitted packet's version field can be inspected to determine whether it contains a reserved version.

requirements.quote: Endpoints MAY send packets with a reserved version to test that a peer correctly discards the packet.
requirements.condition: A peer receives a packet carrying a reserved version.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The peer must not continue processing the packet as a supported-version packet.
requirements.why_checkable: A reserved-version packet can be injected and the implementation can be observed to confirm that it is discarded without supported-version processing.
